segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: initial risk assessment and access decision
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Around 06:40 ... my first thought went straight to the rockburst at our sister operation two months back ... I treated the report as more likely to be heading toward something serious ... I went with enhanced monitoring and limited access.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The elevated initial risk judgment is explicitly linked to recall of the vivid recent sister-mine rockburst despite no current alarm.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The 05:00 baseline was 0.2mm ... By 09:40 it had moved to 0.6mm ... compared to this morning, it's still a small number ... I didn't go back to the GCMP's rate-of-change table.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant explains the comparison rule used to judge the updated extensometer reading and acknowledges that the rate criterion was not applied.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: supervisor credibility weighting and access decision
segments.raw_interview_anchor: He mentioned hearing similar popping back in 2009 ... His track record carried a lot of weight for me in that moment.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Supervisor tenure and reassurance are given substantial weight without checking whether the historical comparison fits current conditions.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: crack comparison and visual evidence interpretation
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Today's crack looked about the same width to me ... I read it as consistent with what we already knew was fine ... I was judging the crack against the old photo instead of against the newer number.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The prior crack photograph and classification are used as the reference while the new seismic threshold is not integrated.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Putting it together ... it read as a pretty clean explanation: cooling stress plus the handover timing plus residual vibration from that blast.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Several plausible factors are presented as one clean causal explanation despite no factor being confirmed as dominant.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I focused mainly on the miner who first reported the sounds ... I did mention the missing engineer sign-off ... but it came across more as a process note than a central cause.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Responsibility is centered on the individual miner while the missing GCMP engineer sign-off is secondary.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Less than when I wrote it. It felt like a complete picture at the time, but there were threads I didn't fully chase down.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a substantive confidence judgment but does not express another hidden bias mechanism.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: Adding low-confidence findings adds one segment hit and one mechanism-first true positive for Experience Bias, but one strict false positive remains because the label is Authority bias.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: Adding candidates adds two segment hits; it adds one strict true positive for Narrative Fallacy, one mechanism-first-only true positive for Attribution Bias, and one strict false positive for the near-neighbor attribution label.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At high_and_moderate, 3 of 6 positive segments were detected with no segment-level false alarms (hit rate 0.5000; F1 0.6667).
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, 3 of 6 hidden instances were strict true positives with no false positives (precision 1.0000; recall 0.5000; F1 0.6667). Counting candidates yields 4 true positives, 2 false negatives, and 2 false positives.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At high_and_moderate, mechanism-first equals strict. Including all identified findings recovers the low-confidence experience mechanism; including candidates recovers all six mechanisms with no mechanism-first false positives.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: Both candidates localize to real hidden instances with full mechanisms. One is strict-matchable because its alternative labels include the exact hidden target; the other is mechanism-first-only because its label is a near neighbor.
main_failure_modes: Experience Bias was labeled Authority bias, producing a strict label error despite a full mechanism match.
The Attribution Bias instance remained candidate-only and used a related but non-equivalent label.
The Narrative Fallacy instance was not promoted to the identified tier.
High-confidence-only evaluation misses all low-confidence and candidate-tier findings.
main_strengths: All four identified occurrences are validly localized with strong interview evidence.
Both distinct anchoring instances were correctly separated by evidence source and decision point.
The analysis disclosed unsupported retrieval coverage and avoided overclaiming candidates.
No unsupported, fabricated, duplicated, or negative-segment predictions were found.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: The run shows strong evidence-level and mechanism-level reasoning, but conservative confidence assignment and two label mismatches reduce strict ontology performance. The counterfactual schedule slack was handled appropriately and was not incorrectly used as the cause of the reasoning patterns.
